transcript.content: Hello, I’m glad you came in today. What brings you in today?

I've been struggling with a lot of low mood and anxiety for about two months now, which started after a really stressful life event. I'm just not coping well with everything, so I decided to come in and get some help.
Was the stressful life event something traumatic, like actual or threatened death, serious injury, or sexual violence? Or was it a major stressor that was upsetting but not life-threatening?
It wasn't life-threatening or traumatic like that, thankfully. It was just a major, really upsetting life stressor that has completely turned my world upside down.
Before this stressful event happened, were you already having excessive worry or anxiety about many different parts of life for at least 6 months? Or did the anxiety begin only after the event?
No, I didn't have any of this worry or anxiety before. It only started after the event happened, and it's been going on for about two months now. Before this, I was actually doing quite well.

Over the past two weeks, have you had depressed mood or loss of interest nearly every day, along with other symptoms like changes in sleep or appetite, low energy, poor concentration, feelings of worthlessness, or thoughts of death?

I've definitely been feeling really down, tearful, and pretty hopeless for the last two months. However, I haven't experienced those other symptoms you mentioned, like changes in my sleep or appetite, or any thoughts of death.
How much has this been affecting your day-to-day functioning, like work, school, relationships, or taking care of yourself?
I'm not entirely sure how much it's affected everything, as I haven't really thought about it deeply. I've just been feeling generally overwhelmed lately and find myself withdrawing from others.
Have you lost interest or pleasure in things you usually enjoy nearly every day over the past two weeks?
I'm not quite sure if I've lost interest in things, to be honest. I haven't really noticed whether that's changed or not lately.

Besides feeling down, have you had low energy, poor concentration, feelings of worthlessness or guilt, or moving or speaking noticeably slower or more restlessly than usual nearly every day for the past two weeks?

I haven't really experienced those specific things like feeling worthless, guilty, or noticing any changes in how I move or speak. While I have definitely been feeling down and hopeless, those other symptoms don't really describe what I've been going through.
Did these symptoms start within about 3 months of the stressful event?
Yes, they definitely did. My symptoms started about a month after the event happened, so it was well within that three-month window. It all began pretty quickly after everything went down.
If the stressful situation has ended, have these symptoms lasted for more than 6 months afterward?
No, they definitely haven't lasted that long. The stressful situation ended recently, and my symptoms have only been going on for about two months in total. So it is well under that six-month mark.
Have these symptoms caused significant problems at work, in relationships, or in taking care of yourself?
I'm not really sure, to be honest. I haven't noticed any major or significant problems with my work, relationships, or taking care of myself.
